dialogues.speaker: Shams
dialogues.text: What's hottest in Sumeru right now is definitely... uh, that canned stuff, pretty rare... Right?

dialogues.speaker: Shams
dialogues.text: *burp* ...Someone like me doesn't have the cushy reserves of the Homayanis. If I want to make money, I have to take risks and do high-end business.

dialogues.speaker: Shams
dialogues.text: People of superior learning may not give a hoot about anything else, but that's not the case when it comes to knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Shams
dialogues.text: Let me tell ya, I got them all figured out... *burp*
